definitions: To receive an improvement in quality, status, or features.
To be moved to a higher class or better accommodation, often without extra cost.
To have a system, software, or device updated to a newer or more advanced version.
examples: I hope to get upgraded on my flight.
Our hotel room might get upgraded if they're overbooked.
The software will get upgraded next month.
Did your phone get upgraded to the latest OS?
They expect their membership to get upgraded soon.
